The Storage of the Bootstrap Entries of a Fit

Source: R/bootstrap_fit.R
boot_env.Rd

boot_env() returns the environment in which a fit keeps its entries, or NULL for a fit that has none (an object saved before the property existed). boot_fit_estimates() returns the numbers that identify the fit an entry belongs to, and boot_entries() the entries that belong to the fit, in alphabetical order of their keys.

Usage

boot_env(fit)

boot_fit_estimates(fit)

boot_entries(fit)

boot_match(ents, resample, refit)

Arguments

fit

A StatmodFit().

ents

A list of entries.

resample, refit

The settings to match, NULL for any.

Value

The environment, a numeric vector, or a list of StatmodBootstrap objects.
